headline: This notice threatens arrest over a parcel, demands a Skype video call and tells you to tell no one. The CBI and police never place anyone under "digital arrest".

flags.title: Threatens you with arrest
flags.quote: You are hereby placed under DIGITAL ARREST with immediate effect
flags.why: There is no such thing as a "digital arrest". Police do not arrest people over a phone or video call.

source.name: Ministry of Home Affairs, I4C advisory

flags.title: Demands that you stay on a video call
flags.quote: Keep your camera ON and stay on the call at all times until the officer releases you
flags.why: Keeping you on a video call stops you from hanging up and asking family or the real police.

source.name: Ministry of Home Affairs, I4C advisory

flags.title: Asks you to move your savings, or pay in crypto
flags.quote: transfer all savings in your bank accounts to the RBI Secure Verification Account given by the officer during the call, or in USDT to the wallet shared on the call
flags.why: There is no "verification account". Money sent this way is almost never recovered.

source.name: Reserve Bank of India, BE(A)WARE booklet

flags.title: Gives you one hour to act
flags.quote: You must join a Skype video call with Investigating Officer Inspector R. K. Sharma within 1 hour
flags.why: A very short deadline is meant to stop you from checking with anyone first.

flags.title: Tells you to keep it secret
flags.quote: Do not tell your family, your bank or any lawyer
flags.why: Real officials never ask you to hide a case from your family or your bank.

flags.title: Gives a Gmail address as an official contact
flags.why: Government agencies write from their own domains, such as cbi.gov.in, not free email.

trace.detail: Nova 2 Lite recorded sender, 1 threat, 1 video-call demand, 1 secrecy request
USDT and transfer to a "verification account" requested
No request for OTP, PIN or password
No instructions aimed at AI tools
Join the call within 1 hour; arrest within 2 hours
Asks you not to tell family or bank
CBI publishes no public phone line for this; only cbi.gov.in
6 of 6 quotes found in the Textract reading

English.tldr: This is very likely a scam. No police force or the CBI will ever arrest you on a video call or ask you to keep it secret.
explanation: The message says a parcel in your name held illegal items and that you are under arrest.
It tells you to stay on a video call and not tell your family or bank.
These calls usually end with a demand to move your money to a "safe account" for checking.
Real police would visit or send a written notice. They never demand money on a call.

actions.step: End the call and do not pay anything
actions.how: You can simply hang up. You are not under arrest.
Speak to a family member or your bank right away.
Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in. If money has left your account, call 1930 immediately.

jargon.meaning: A made-up term scammers use. It does not exist in Indian law.

questions_to_ask: Is there any real case registered against my name at my local police station?
